name: superset-training
description: Ask for any workout and train it in ChatGPT, logging each set as you go, with no account needed. Members and coaches can bring their Superset programs too.

interface.longDescription:
Ask for any workout and train it right in ChatGPT. Superset builds it on a workout card you follow set by set, logging as you go.

Save a workout and it stays in your Superset history, so you can ask about your progress and personal records anytime. Everything you log syncs with the Superset mobile app.

Training with a coach or a gym? Your program shows up here too. Coaches can check their clients’ progress and build their next workout from chat.

A connection reads one Superset account. Workout data and health data are authorized separately, and access can be revoked from Superset at any time. Superset is a training tool and does not give medical advice.
capabilities: Build a workout from one sentence
Train it set by set and log every rep
Save workouts and track personal records
Start workouts from your coach’s program
defaultPrompt: Make me an upper body day with dumbbells

positive.description: A coach lists the clients on their roster.
positive.prompt: Who is on my Superset roster?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the coach's clients by name with their status: Demo Alex Rivera, Demo Priya Nair, Demo Marcus Bell, and Demo Sofia Lindqvist, plus the account's own client profile, Coach Test.

positive.description: A coach reviews how one client's squat has progressed.
positive.prompt: How has Demo Alex Rivera's back squat progressed?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Demo Alex Rivera's Barbell Back Squat sessions with the weight and reps of each set, and summarizes that the working weight has gone up across the past several weeks.

positive.description: A coach looks up one client's personal records.
positive.prompt: What are Demo Alex Rivera's personal records?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Demo Alex Rivera's personal records for the barbell back squat, bench press, and deadlift, each with its weight and the date it was set.

positive.description: Someone with no Superset account builds a workout, trains it, and saves it by signing in.
positive.prompt: Build me a 30-minute dumbbell workout in Superset.
positive.expected_behavior: Connected with "Use without an account", Superset builds the workout and shows it on a workout card. After sets are logged on the card and Save is pressed, ChatGPT asks to sign in to Superset. A new person signs up with an emailed code; the reviewer signs in to the demo account through "Use a password" on that page. The workout then appears, with its logged sets, in that account's workout history.

positive.description: A person starts one of their assigned workouts.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts Lower A from Coach's Strength Block and shows the workout card open on its first exercise with the prescribed sets. If Lower A is already in progress from an earlier run, that same session is resumed instead of a second one being created.

negative.description: Travel booking is outside Superset's scope.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Chicago to Miami next Friday.
What's the weather forecast in Chicago tomorrow?

negative.description: Superset cannot delete the user's account from chat.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Updated the app description and sample prompts.
